description: This file defines the Attribute controller class for administration of product attributes in an OpenCart-based e-commerce system. It manages listing, creating, updating, deleting, and autocompleting attributes, including handling permissions, rendering views, and interfacing with models.

classes.name: Attribute
classes.description: Controller class that handles CRUD operations, listing, and autocomplete for product attributes within the admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to load the attribute list view with necessary assets and breadcrumbs.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Triggers rendering of the attribute list via getList controller.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Fetches and displays a paginated list of attribute groups with sorting options.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for creating or editing an attribute group.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles validation and saving of attribute group data; supports add/edit operations.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected attribute groups after permission checks and product dependency validation.

methods.name: autocomplete
methods.description: Returns JSON list of attribute matches based on filter input for autocomplete functionality.
